comment: CF02-AUDIO (COMBAT-FUN-02 Q24, Q27, Q36): the cf02 cue overlay. Maps the five new IP-neutral engine cue ids (src/audio.rs, CueId::CF02) to the event ids of docs/audio_events_cf02.json. It is read into the cue bank always but only emitted under cf02_rules, so the global cue_map.json, audio_events.json and asset_manifest.json stay byte-identical and --demo sounds like the tested DEMO-01.

reuse.comment: Causes that keep an existing cue under the overlay (no new file). Documentation only; the mapping itself is code (cues_from_combat_event_cf02) and unit-tested.
